confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no listings or price pages were checked and no web-sourced price data was used. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by beach area and season. Cocktail and wine are set from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 2.5 times beer, wine glass about 2 times beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. FX is unconfirmed: a search summary attributed 0.7002 (14 Oct 2026) to the RBA homepage, I did not open that page, and a follow-up search did not corroborate it; verify against RBA table F11.1 before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Thai island and beach-resort pricing in Southeast Asia, using Koh Samui tourist-area price levels as the reference, informed by general knowledge of comparable Thai beach destinations such as Phuket and Krabi. No single city was used as a fixed price source.
